description: Freshness SLAs (docs/plan.md 4.5): a row is stale when the whole UTC days from its last_verified_at date to the build/read date exceed sla_days. The first matching rule wins; a rule key that is absent matches anything. Row type comes first so a volatile subscription is still a subscription.

volatile_api.description: API pricing that moves often (fetch_recipe.volatility high).

standard_api.description: API pricing at the default cadence.
